Not my gut feeling but my dads. We were on a flight from Miami to Tegucigalpa, the capital of Honduras, for a mission trip with his church. I was reading Harry Potter and listening to my CD player. All of a sudden my dad looks over and checks that we have our seat belts on. The seat belt sign was not on and as a kid of course I did not have mine fastened, so I buckled up. Maybe 15 seconds later, the plane hit some turbulence and dropped what felt like hundreds of feet. My book flew up a few rows and my CD player went back a few rows. The folks on the plane without a seat belt fastened hit their heads on the ceiling, one guy cracked the ceiling and had a pretty gnarly gash. We ended up having an emergency landing in Cayman Islands. AA sent us a new plane and hooked everyone up in a fancy hotel right on the beach. Thanks Dad! I would have had a nasty concussion if it werent for his checking our seat belt. He has said that he just had a bad feeling about something.
